info.description: Generated from the emulator's route declarations. It describes the HTTP surface only: this television also answers on transports OpenAPI cannot express, which `tvemu --api-map` lists in full.

post.summary: One remote key over plain HTTP ECP.

403.description: An answer observed in capture evidence.

schema.description:
The key name is judged before the access mode, so an unknown key is 400 even where every key would be refused.
Unlike a refused query, a refused key carries no words and no Content-Type.
Refused before the key name, so even an unknown key is 401 and not 400 is read, with neither words nor a Content-Type. The device documents, SSDP and an authenticated ecp-2 session keep working.
The same rule as ecp-2: releasing a key nobody pressed is accepted as 202.

post.summary: Launch a channel by its ECP id.

401.description: An answer observed in capture evidence.

schema.description:
Refused before the channel id, so an unknown channel is 401 and not 404 is read, with neither words nor a Content-Type. The device documents, SSDP and an authenticated ecp-2 session keep working.
The set checks the id against its installed channels. The emulator accepts any id, so a driver's launch can be observed without a catalogue.

schema.description:
The 12.0.0 stick capture has no device-info exchange; 15.x answers it.
Refused before the query is read, with neither words nor a Content-Type. The device documents, SSDP and an authenticated ecp-2 session keep working.
Every element is optional and names are case sensitive (has-wifi-5G-support). Every value is XML text: numeric-looking elements are strings, and av-sync-calibration-enabled answers "3.0".

schema.description:
Refused before the query is read, with neither words nor a Content-Type. The device documents, SSDP and an authenticated ecp-2 session keep working.
Not a copy of the ecp-2 document: the envelope's gives every appl a subtype (ndka, rsga, sdka, and it moves -- Netflix answered ndka, then rsga) that the HTTP list of the same set leaves out.
Refused before the set looks for the document, so the channel it names does not matter. The authenticated ecp-2 session is not restricted.
